- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow patterns with usage-based forecasting and customer value realization.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates, managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and governed exit dispositions from intake through monitoring.
- bul_unify_005: Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS, Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
